promptHead: Athlete goal: marathon (Wexley Lakes Marathon) on Sun Nov 1 2026, 8 weeks out, target under 3:45.

new.headline: Keep volume steady this week and focus on quality without chasing lost miles.

answers.question: I missed Thursday and cut the long run short. Should I make up the miles next week?
answers.answer: No, you don’t need to chase the missed miles. Keep the week’s volume the same and focus on quality today. If you feel you can add a medium run, do it; otherwise let the rest day after the long run allow full recovery.

new.analysis:
I will answer the athlete's question: missing Thursday run and short long run. They do not need to make up miles now; focus on volume stability and quality. My plan for the week will keep the same five days, add a mid‑week medium run only if needed, but keep a rest day after the long run to avoid overreaching. The long run will be 14 miles easy to allow recovery.

Flags: missing a Thursday run means we must keep volume stable; short long run means we should avoid running too hard immediately after; heat and HR drift are concerns; sleep deficit should be monitored; overall easy‑run share is low.

I will not include any medical or diagnosis, just advice. No safety callouts needed.
